title: All Aboard
description: Caltrain next-train demo: nearest station, next north/south trains, live departure predictions from 511.org StopMonitoring when configured, and routed walk/bike ETAs through a server-side directions action. White-board Contract/Exact surface under a Caltrain-red station header with day-rotating hand-drawn scenes (ENG-23719), over generated Snapback artifacts — gesture-driven on web (surface glue), native macOS/iOS-ready.

backend.stalenessPolicy: committed; regenerate seed then codegen after editing shared/model.mjs

egress.note: Phase 3 egress seam; requires codegen of the probe fixture with SNAPBACK_OUTBOUND_ACTIONS=1.

real-data.note: Product action path against local 511 StopMonitoring + OpenRouteService mocks; requires SNAPBACK_OUTBOUND_ACTIONS=1 at runtime.

contract.devServer: bun run --cwd demos/all-aboard/surfaces/contract dev (Exact from the npm registry: @exact/* alias deps -> @ccheever/exact-*, ENG-22480; surfaces/contract/bun.lock is the pin — it replaced exact.pin.json; one-time `bun install --cwd demos/all-aboard/surfaces/contract`)
contract.build: bun run --cwd demos/all-aboard/surfaces/contract build (vite build via the installed exactContractWeb preset -> surfaces/contract/dist/web/; configured to emit __exact/native/mac-appkit-hermes and __exact/native/ios-uikit-hermes)
contract.toolchain: node>=24, cargo, bun, local Google Chrome (CDP); Exact installs from the npm registry (no checkout)
contract.gestureGlue: swipe left/right = station, swipe up/down = train, bare tap = flip direction, arrow keys on desktop — implemented as web surface glue (surfaces/contract/gestures.ts) dispatching the declared press affordances; NOT a Contract primitive (LLP 0029 G1 stays open)

native.note: The same app.contract renders on macOS/iOS through the Exact ExactApp kernel host. The surface build emits static native envelopes for mac-appkit-hermes and ios-uikit-hermes under surfaces/contract/dist/web/__exact/native/; with the current registry Exact devtools package they carry module-bundle.json fallback payloads instead of startup.js/HBC.

react-control.devServer: bun run --cwd demos/all-aboard/surfaces/react dev (stock React 19 + Vite from the surface's own node_modules)
react-control.note: Red-team control arm (ENG-22435; re-baselined to the redesigned poster-board product by ENG-22450): the same product, testIds, D4 boot, and stream-transport live push over the shared kit client, web-only. Its suite mirrors the contract browser list check-for-check (15/15).

headless: durable static schedule (21 stations north->south, 6 patterns, indexed stopTimes) is queryable
assumed-direction inference matches the SF/22nd/Bayshore/South SF rule
nearest-station selection from lat/lng resolves the expected station
next-north/next-south minutes-away are exact under a frozen 9:00am Pacific clock
applying a recorded feed tick shifts the exact prediction (sb-limited 0 -> 180s)
a refresh mutation pushes a live-query delta and advances the durable storage version
feedRefreshState freshness marker tracks the refresh
cron: the warm-poll job is registered from the manifest and targets the refresh action
demand activation: inactive with no subscribers, armed while a rider is subscribed, inactive again on disconnect
a scheduler tick runs the action -> mutation -> live-query delta
the refresh is committed through the mutation (feed marker + cron trigger)
the run is recorded in the observable cron ledger
egress: with SNAPBACK_OUTBOUND_ACTIONS on, an action sees a callable fetch and a scoped ctx.secrets key pool
a query in the same runtime is still denied fetch
by default (flag off) even an action is denied fetch
real-data: /action/{name} runs only actions and rejects non-actions without executing them

refreshFeed parses 511 StopMonitoring JSON — served the way the real api.511.org sends it (UTF-8 BOM + gzip) — and commits mappable Caltrain departure rows to liveDepartures plus coarse status rows to trainStatus
routeEstimate uses a server-side OpenRouteService/HeiGIT directions call for station-card walk/bike ETAs
a caltrainFeed key set through /_snapback/api/config/set (the setup-page path) reaches the live fetch
a failing live fetch falls back to the recorded feed with an actionable lastError that never contains the API key
contract: .contract compiles against generated Snapback descriptors and mounts against a live backend
geolocation-denied fallback selects the nearest station to the default location
press affordances drive station navigation and direction toggle (identical on web and native)
tapping a train opens its detail with ordered stops and a position indicator
the refresh affordance drives refreshFeed through the app action route and the freshness marker goes live
the feed-problem line says why the board is not on live 511 data (actionable fallback reason, ENG-22751)
paved path: liveTrainStatus + liveDepartures + feedState bind with server push over the shared stream; connections report live (LLP 0034 D1)
cron-authored delta reaches the browser through generated bindings with no poll pump (Exact LLP 0284 §5.3 item 3)
second window boot is inspect-first and does not clear the first window (LLP 0034 D4 / LLP 0275 C4)
paging strips declare physically adjacent cards at ±100% — no blank neighbors mid-gesture (ENG-23795)
gesture glue: header swipes page to the adjacent station, board swipes page the selected train, sheets go back on swipe right (region-scoped synthetic pointers, ENG-23719/ENG-23795)
train rows select on tap and sooner trains stay visible in compact form when a later train is selected (ENG-23795)
the sticky footer carries the status dot (green live / gray not, honest non-live label), the location indicator, the Switch-to direction control, and system-style refresh/settings icons (ENG-23795)
the footer gear opens the settings sheet (no bottom tabs, ENG-23719)

directions: tap on the distance line opens the preferred maps app; long-press opens the bottom sheet with Apple/Google/copy-address actions; the maps-app preference cycles in Settings and persists (ENG-23795)
the stations list carries the end-of-line hint — ellipsis + terminal stop + arrival time (ENG-23795)
the Settings ETA mode toggles walk/bike estimates app-wide (E4, ENG-22450; auto default resolves to bike beyond an 18-minute walk, ENG-23795)
react-control: the React arm is a paved-road control at its ENG-22450 baseline (pre-ENG-23719 design) with its own suite (browser-react.mjs); it does not track product redesigns check-for-check

temporaryPolicy.feed: refreshFeed polls 511.org SIRI StopMonitoring for Caltrain when SNAPBACK_OUTBOUND_ACTIONS and caltrainFeed config are present, writing liveDepartures for real predicted board rows; otherwise it advances recorded fallback ticks and records lastError; 180s warm-poll cadence with a transactional one-poll-per-180s upstream budget (claimFeedPoll) and a 390s LIVE-badge freshness window (ENG-23642)
temporaryPolicy.clock: predictions use the client's local time; the seed schedule is authored in Pacific (fixed-offset simplification)
temporaryPolicy.walkBike: selected-station card uses routeEstimate through a server-side OpenRouteService/HeiGIT action when directions config is present; haversine remains the deterministic fallback and station-list estimate
temporaryPolicy.stationArt: header scenes are the ENG-23684 hand-drawn originals (3 per station, 640x1136 SVG), inlined by scripts/gen-station-art.mjs into station-art.gen.mjs (~0.9MB source) and rotated by epoch day (ENG-23719) — zero runtime egress, deterministic, no attribution needed; the older poster-stylized Wikimedia photo module (station-photos.gen.mjs, ~1.5MB, credit line required) remains for the React control arm; flowing assets through the asset-storage subsystem instead of inlining is the follow-up
temporaryPolicy.egress: opt-in via SNAPBACK_OUTBOUND_ACTIONS; product fetches are action-scoped and secret-backed, but the runtime grant is still coarse network:fetch rather than per-host allowlisted
temporaryPolicy.gestures: gesture-first interaction ships as web surface glue (gestures.ts) dragging the declared 3-cell paging strips 1:1 and dispatching the declared press affordances (ENG-23795); the Contract swipe primitive (LLP 0029 G1) remains the real fix and would delete the glue
temporaryPolicy.mapsApps: the directions affordance declares press= and longpress= (longpress is a real Contract event; native host-ops deliver EventType.LongPress) opening the actions sheet; on web, tap-to-open-maps, the long-press timer (the DOM mirror does not deliver onLongPress yet — filed separately), copy-address, and the persisted maps-app preference are glue (directions.ts); hosts without the glue open the sheet on press and its actions only dismiss — native URL-opening/clipboard host capabilities are the real fix (ENG-23795)
temporaryPolicy.webChrome: the Exact plugin's shell 'auto' mode preserves the surface's own index.html (ENG-22445), which carries the page chrome; main.ts installWebChrome keeps an idempotent copy of the same rules so the surface also survives generated-shell hosts (height chain, dark backdrop, touch-action rules)

notClaiming: exact static GTFS schedule parity or GTFS-RT trip-to-schedule identity matching
swipe/pan gestures as a Contract primitive (web glue drags the declared paging strips; press affordances stand in)
native maps-app deep-linking or clipboard (web glue opens URLs and copies; native hosts get the sheet without those side effects)
a running native macOS/iOS shell in this repo
a per-host egress allowlist (coarse network:fetch only)
a high-frequency position fan-out scale benchmark
